title: Arcane Precision
summary: Arcane Precision is an Arcane Enhancement that increases Damage for secondaries for 18 seconds upon achieving a headshot.
extract:
Arcane Precision is an Arcane Enhancement that increases Damage for secondaries for 18 seconds upon achieving a headshot. 
Can be sold for  1,000.

Effect

Acquisition
Awarded for killing or capturing the Eidolon Gantulyst.
Dropped in Rotation C of Orphix Venus Proxima or Veil Proxima missions.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

History
Arcane Precision was first introduced in the Trial mission The Jordas Verdict, which was retired in Update 22.14 (2018-03-01).
The Operation: Scarlet Spear event sold Arcane Precision from Little Duck for 2,000  Scarlet Credits.
The Operation: Orphix Venom event sold Arcane Precision from Father for 400  Phasic Cells.
The Operation: Gargoyle's Cry event sold Arcane Precision from the Vigile Jahu Gargoyle for 6  Grotesque Splinter.
The Operation: Belly of the Beast event sold Arcane Precision from Ordis for 5  Volatile Motes in the first run of the event, and 6 Motes in the second, with a purchase limit of 42.
The Operation: Eight Claw event sold Arcane Precision from Dominus Thrax in bundles of 7, costing 4  Dominus Aureus, with a purchase limit of 3 (21 Arcanes in total).

Notes
The increase in damage stacks additively with mods that increase base damage e.g.  Hornet Strike.
Works with  Mesa's  Peacemaker but practically requires activation beforehand, as  Regulators almost always do body shots.
Works with  Titania's  Dex Pixia, can be activated while in  Razorwing mode. While in that mode, Titania's Razorfly Drones have a ?% chance to land a headshot on enemies, triggering the Arcane. This allows her to have near 100% uptime passively (except in very early content where enemy density is very low and enemies die in one hit from the Razorflies alone).
Works with  Dante's  Noctua.
Only works with  Hildryn's  Balefire Charger or  Jade's  Glory if it procs a status effect that can headshot, like  Electricity or  Gas, or by activation beforehand.
Headshots from any weapon can activate the buff. This includes primary, secondary, and melee weapons, also Archguns, and gear tools such as the  Tranq Rifle and  Nosam Cutter, including companion attacks (including those summoned from Duplex Bond)  by direct hit or status effect that can headshot.
Further headshots will not refresh the duration of the buff, unlike other headshot-based arcanes, such as  Arcane Consequence and  Arcane Rage.

Bugs
Base  Regulators has an additional +30%/60%/90%/120%/180% damage bonus on top of the secondary damage bonus.  Regulators Prime works as normal.
